page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr9i.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The processing power is delivered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz.

This instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage options. The network configuration provides a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density, the ecs.hfr9i.8xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity without the overhead of local storage. It is suitable for memory-intensive applications, including relational databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning (ERP) applications, and large-scale data processing tasks.
